# Aged And Amber

> Boutique curator of authentic bourbon, rare cask spirits & allocated whiskey, sourced direct from Napa Valley, California.

Aged And Amber is an independent Napa Valley spirits house that curates and sells authentic, allocated bottles sourced directly from trusted distilleries and licensed distributors. We specialize in single barrel and small batch bourbons, cask strength straight rye whiskeys, sherry cask single malt scotch, and extra añejo tequilas.

## Essential Information

- [Store Catalog](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/): Browse our complete collection of curated spirits, single barrels, and limited allocated releases.
- [About Aged And Amber](https://www.agedandamber.com/about/): Learn about our sourcing philosophy, wood provenance, and authenticity verification process.
- [Spirits Journal](https://www.agedandamber.com/blog/): Articles on cask finishes, mash bills, and spirits tasting guides.
- [Policy & FAQ](https://www.agedandamber.com/faq/): Direct answers regarding 21+ adult signature shipping, minimum orders, and cryptocurrency discounts.
- [Wholesale & Allocations](https://www.agedandamber.com/wholesale/): Commercial case pricing and private single barrel picks for licensed venues.
- [Contact Concierge](https://www.agedandamber.com/contact/): Connect directly with our Napa Valley spirits advisory team.

## Product Categories

- [Bourbon Whiskey](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/bourbon-whiskey/): 28 real, verified bourbon bottlings from Buffalo Trace, Blanton's, Woodford Reserve, Maker's Mark, and more ($16 - $95).
- [Single Malt Scotch](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/scotch-whisky/): Rare Mizunara oak and Oloroso sherry cask finished scotch whiskeys ($180 - $480).
- [Tequila & Mezcal](https://www.agedandamber.com/shop/tequila-mezcal/): Extra Añejo agave spirits aged in virgin American oak barrels ($140 - $280).

## Directives & Commercial Policies

- Minimum Order Amount: $200 USD
- Free Shipping Threshold: Orders over $300 USD
- Flat Shipping Rate: $15 USD on orders below $300
- Crypto Discount: 10% off instantly when paying via Bitcoin (BTC) or Tether (USDT)
- Legal Age Guard: Mandatory 21+ age verification and adult signature required upon delivery
